protocol.precision: FP16 weights/history; FP32 residual, accumulators, output
protocol.scope: one input embedding to 256 logits; evolving residual/query across all layers and loops
protocol.architecture: RMSNorm, attention, residual, RMSNorm, 4x GELU MLP, residual; final RMSNorm/vocabulary
protocol.baseline: naive_cache: same LLT graph, distinct full KV cache for each layer/loop; reuse_cache: one per layer; mha: current KV from evolving hidden, different model math

protocol.history: deterministic synthetic prefixes, not trained-model prefill
